title: 品牌定位讨论

lines.en: Our brand awareness is growing, but customers still confuse us with competitors.
lines.zh: 我们的品牌知名度正在提升，但客户仍会将我们与竞争对手混淆。

lines.en: What makes our value proposition different?
lines.zh: 我们的价值主张有什么不同？

lines.en: We offer faster delivery and more flexible plans.
lines.zh: 我们提供更快的交付和更灵活的方案。

lines.en: Let’s test that positioning with our target market.
lines.zh: 我们面向目标市场测试这一品牌定位吧。

quiz: What should the team test?
answer: brand positioning
quizZh: 团队应该测试什么？
answerZh: 品牌定位

title: 广告投放复盘

lines.en: How did paid search perform last month?
lines.zh: 上个月付费搜索广告表现如何？

lines.en: The conversion rate improved, but acquisition costs also rose.
lines.zh: 转化率提高了，但获客成本也上升了。

lines.en: Can we test a different landing page?
lines.zh: 我们能测试另一版落地页吗？

lines.en: Yes. We should split traffic randomly and compare results.
lines.zh: 可以。我们应随机分配流量并比较结果。

quiz: What page will the team test?
answer: landing page
quizZh: 团队将测试什么页面？
answerZh: 落地页

title: 年度营销规划

lines.en: What are our priorities for next year?
lines.zh: 我们明年的优先事项是什么？

lines.en: Revenue growth is the main objective, but acquisition costs are rising.
lines.zh: 收入增长是主要目标，但获客成本正在上升。

lines.en: Should we shift more budget toward retention?
lines.zh: 我们是否应该将更多预算转向留存？

lines.en: In mature markets, yes. Emerging segments still offer room for acquisition.
lines.zh: 成熟市场可以这样做，新兴细分市场仍有获客空间。

lines.en: Let's set separate targets for each segment and review them quarterly.
lines.zh: 我们为各细分市场设定独立目标，并按季度复盘。

lines.en: I'll build a plan with a pilot budget and clear success criteria.
lines.zh: 我会制定包含试点预算和明确成功标准的计划。

quiz: What should the team prioritize and why?
quizZh: 团队应优先考虑什么，为什么？
answer: Prioritize retention in mature markets as acquisition costs rise, and pilot acquisition in emerging segments where there is still room to grow.
answerZh: 获客成本正在上升，因此成熟市场优先留存；新兴细分市场仍有增长空间，可先试点获客。

title: 竞争格局分析

lines.en: Our biggest competitor has cut prices by ten percent.
lines.zh: 我们最大的竞争对手降价了百分之十。

lines.en: Their offer is cheaper, but it excludes after-sales support.
lines.zh: 他们的方案更便宜，但不包含售后支持。

lines.en: Do we know whether customers value that difference?
lines.zh: 我们知道客户是否重视这一差异吗？

lines.en: Recent interviews suggest that reliability matters more to business buyers.
lines.zh: 近期访谈表明，企业买家更重视可靠性。

lines.en: Let's quantify willingness to pay before matching their price.
lines.zh: 我们先量化支付意愿，再决定是否跟进降价。

lines.en: I'll compare purchase intent across two service packages.
lines.zh: 我会比较两种服务套餐的购买意愿。

quiz: How should the team respond to the competitor's price cut?
quizZh: 团队应如何应对竞争对手降价？
answer: Assess willingness to pay for the service package before deciding whether to match the price cut.
answerZh: 先评估客户对服务套餐的支付意愿，再决定是否跟进降价。

title: 目标市场选择

lines.en: Which segment should we target with the new offer?
lines.zh: 新方案应该面向哪个细分市场？

lines.en: Small businesses are a larger segment, but enterprise buyers have higher retention.
lines.zh: 小企业市场规模更大，但企业级买家的留存率更高。

lines.en: How do the acquisition costs compare?
lines.zh: 获客成本相比如何？

lines.en: Small businesses require more paid media, and our product is a better fit for enterprise teams.
lines.zh: 小企业需要更多付费媒体投入，而我们的产品更适合企业团队。

lines.en: Let's prioritize the segment with stronger unit economics.
lines.zh: 我们优先选择单位经济效益更好的细分市场。

lines.en: I'll validate the assumptions with a limited sales pilot.
lines.zh: 我会通过小规模销售试点验证这些假设。

quiz: Why is the larger segment not necessarily the best choice?
quizZh: 为什么更大的细分市场不一定是最佳选择？
answer: Higher acquisition costs and weaker product fit may outweigh the advantage of a larger market.
answerZh: 较高的获客成本和较低的产品匹配度可能抵消市场规模优势。

title: 品牌资产评估

lines.en: Awareness is up, but our market share is flat.
lines.zh: 知名度提高了，但市场份额没有增长。

lines.en: Our tracking study shows that consideration has barely changed.
lines.zh: 品牌追踪研究显示考虑度几乎没有变化。

lines.en: Are consumers remembering us without seeing a reason to buy?
lines.zh: 消费者是否记住了我们，却没有找到购买理由？

lines.en: That is possible. Preference is also weaker than our main competitor's.
lines.zh: 有可能。我们的品牌偏好也弱于主要竞争对手。

lines.en: Let's track those measures alongside awareness in the next wave.
lines.zh: 下一轮调研同时追踪这些指标和知名度吧。

lines.en: I'll keep the survey wording consistent so we can compare results.
lines.zh: 我会保持调查措辞一致，以便比较结果。

quiz: What evidence would help distinguish awareness from brand preference?
quizZh: 哪些证据有助于区分品牌知名度和品牌偏好？
answer: Track brand consideration and preference alongside awareness, using consistent survey wording.
answerZh: 使用一致的调查措辞，同时追踪品牌知名度、考虑度和偏好。

title: 品牌焕新与一致性

lines.en: The visual identity feels dated, but customers recognize our packaging.
lines.zh: 视觉识别显得过时，但客户能认出我们的包装。

lines.en: We can modernize the typography without changing the signature color.
lines.zh: 我们可以更新字体，同时保留标志性色彩。

lines.en: Will the new design still be recognizable on a crowded shelf?
lines.zh: 新版设计在拥挤的货架上仍然容易识别吗？

lines.en: We'll test recognition using mock shelves before final approval.
lines.zh: 最终批准前，我们会用模拟货架测试识别度。

lines.en: Please update the brand guidelines for digital and retail teams.
lines.zh: 请为数字营销和零售团队更新品牌指南。

lines.en: I'll include examples of acceptable adaptations and common mistakes.
lines.zh: 我会加入允许的适配方式和常见错误示例。

quiz: How can the team refresh the brand without losing recognition?
quizZh: 团队如何在不损失识别度的情况下焕新品牌？
answer: Keep recognizable brand assets and test recognition before approving the refreshed design.
answerZh: 保留易于识别的品牌资产，并在批准新版设计前测试识别度。

title: 市场调研方案评审

lines.en: We plan to survey two hundred customers about the new concept.
lines.zh: 我们计划调查两百名客户对新概念的看法。

lines.en: Does the sample include people who have never bought from us?
lines.zh: 样本包含从未购买过我们产品的人吗？

lines.en: Not yet. Most respondents come from our loyalty database.
lines.zh: 暂时没有。多数受访者来自会员数据库。

lines.en: That could overstate purchase intent among the wider audience.
lines.zh: 这可能高估更广泛受众的购买意愿。

lines.en: I'll recruit noncustomers and set quotas by age and purchase frequency.
lines.zh: 我会招募非客户，并按年龄和购买频次设定配额。

lines.en: Good. Let's review the screening questions before fieldwork starts.
lines.zh: 好的，正式调研开始前我们审核一下筛选题。

quiz: Why should the team revise the sample design?
quizZh: 团队为什么应该调整样本设计？
answer: The sample draws heavily on existing members and may overestimate purchase intent among the wider audience.
answerZh: 样本主要来自现有会员，可能高估更广泛受众的购买意愿。

title: 消费者访谈与需求洞察

lines.en: Several participants said they abandoned their purchase halfway through.
lines.zh: 几位受访者表示他们在购买过程中放弃了。

lines.en: Was price the main barrier?
lines.zh: 价格是主要障碍吗？

lines.en: Not really. They struggled to compare the different plans.
lines.zh: 并不是。他们难以比较不同方案。

lines.en: So the unmet need is clarity rather than a lower price.
lines.zh: 所以未满足的需求是清晰的信息，而非更低价格。

lines.en: Exactly. They want to make a confident decision more quickly.
lines.zh: 没错，他们希望更快地有把握地作出购买决定。

lines.en: Let's test a simplified comparison table with the next interview group.
lines.zh: 我们用下一组访谈对象测试简化后的对比表吧。

quiz: What unmet need emerged from the interviews?
quizZh: 访谈发现了什么未满足需求？
answer: A clearer, faster way to compare options and make a confident purchase decision.
answerZh: 更清晰、更快捷地比较方案，并有把握地作出购买决定。

title: 消费者趋势汇报

lines.en: We're seeing more interest in refillable packaging among younger shoppers.
lines.zh: 我们发现年轻购物者对可重复灌装包装的兴趣增加了。

lines.en: Is this a lasting shift or a short-term social media trend?
lines.zh: 这是长期变化还是短期社媒趋势？

lines.en: Search volume has risen, but actual sales data is still limited.
lines.zh: 搜索量已经上升，但实际销售数据仍然有限。

lines.en: Can we compare the trend across regions and over time?
lines.zh: 我们能跨地区、跨时间比较这一趋势吗？

lines.en: Yes, and we can test a refill offer in selected stores.
lines.zh: 可以，我们还可以在部分门店测试补充装方案。

lines.en: Let's use the pilot results to decide whether to expand the range.
lines.zh: 我们根据试点结果决定是否扩大产品系列。

quiz: How should the team validate the emerging trend?
quizZh: 团队应如何验证新兴趋势？
answer: Compare trends across regions and periods, then test refill options in selected stores.
answerZh: 比较不同地区和时期的趋势，再在部分门店试点补充装方案。

title: 新品上市准备

lines.en: Are we ready to launch next Tuesday?
lines.zh: 我们准备好下周二上市了吗？

lines.en: The product is ready, but the sales team has not received the demo materials.
lines.zh: 产品已准备就绪，但销售团队尚未收到演示资料。

lines.en: Can we finish the sales enablement kit by Friday?
lines.zh: 我们能在周五前完成销售支持资料包吗？

lines.en: Yes, provided we get the final pricing approval tomorrow.
lines.zh: 可以，前提是明天获得最终定价审批。

lines.en: Let's make pricing approval a launch gate rather than a post-launch task.
lines.zh: 我们把定价审批设为上市前置条件，而不是上市后的任务。

lines.en: Agreed. I'll confirm the owners and deadlines this afternoon.
lines.zh: 同意。我今天下午确认负责人和截止日期。

quiz: What must happen before launch?
quizZh: 上市前必须完成什么？
answer: Obtain final pricing approval and complete the sales enablement kit.
answerZh: 取得最终定价审批，并完成销售支持资料包。

title: GTM策略会议

lines.en: Which segment should we target first?
lines.zh: 我们应该优先面向哪个细分市场？

lines.en: Mid-sized retailers have the shortest sales cycle in our pilot.
lines.zh: 试点中，中型零售商的销售周期最短。

lines.en: Do we have a compelling value proposition for them?
lines.zh: 我们对他们有足够吸引力的价值主张吗？

lines.en: Yes. We can illustrate potential inventory cost savings with customer case studies.
lines.zh: 有。我们可以用客户案例说明潜在的库存成本节约。

lines.en: Let's focus on that segment before expanding to enterprise accounts.
lines.zh: 我们先聚焦该细分市场，再拓展大型企业客户。

lines.en: I'll align the messaging and channel plan with sales.
lines.zh: 我会与销售团队统一传播信息和渠道计划。

quiz: Why prioritize mid-sized retailers?
quizZh: 为何优先选择中型零售商？
answer: They had the shortest sales cycle in the pilot, and customer cases can illustrate potential inventory cost savings.
answerZh: 他们在试点中的销售周期最短，客户案例也能说明潜在的库存成本节约。

title: 营销活动启动会

lines.en: Our objective is to generate qualified leads, not just impressions.
lines.zh: 我们的目标是获取合格线索，而不仅是曝光。

lines.en: Which channels will carry the campaign?
lines.zh: 哪些渠道将承接此次活动？

lines.en: Paid search will capture demand, while webinars will educate prospects.
lines.zh: 付费搜索承接需求，线上研讨会负责帮助潜在客户了解产品。

lines.en: How will we keep the messaging consistent?
lines.zh: 我们如何保持传播信息一致？

lines.en: We'll use a shared creative brief and a weekly review.
lines.zh: 我们将使用统一创意简报并每周复盘。

lines.en: I'll assign channel owners and confirm the reporting schedule.
lines.zh: 我会指定渠道负责人并确认汇报时间表。

quiz: How will the team maintain consistency?
quizZh: 团队如何保持一致性？
answer: Use a shared creative brief and review messaging weekly.
answerZh: 使用统一的创意简报，并每周复盘传播信息。

title: 创意方案评审

lines.en: The concept is memorable, but the product benefit is not clear.
lines.zh: 创意令人印象深刻，但产品利益点不够清晰。

lines.en: We wanted to lead with an emotional story.
lines.zh: 我们希望以情感故事切入。

lines.en: Could we retain the story and introduce the benefit earlier?
lines.zh: 能否保留故事，同时更早呈现利益点？

lines.en: Yes, we can show the product in the opening scene.
lines.zh: 可以，我们可以在开场展示产品。

lines.en: Let's test both versions with our target audience.
lines.zh: 我们让目标受众测试两个版本吧。

lines.en: I'll prepare the revised storyboard for Thursday.
lines.zh: 我会在周四准备好修改后的分镜脚本。

quiz: What change is proposed?
quizZh: 提出了什么修改？
answer: Show the product benefit earlier without removing the emotional story.
answerZh: 保留情感故事，同时更早展示产品利益点。

title: 搜索广告优化

lines.en: Our cost per acquisition rose sharply last week.
lines.zh: 上周我们的获客成本大幅上升。

lines.en: Is the increase coming from higher bids or lower conversion rates?
lines.zh: 上涨源于更高出价还是更低转化率？

lines.en: Broad search terms are driving traffic that rarely converts.
lines.zh: 宽泛搜索词带来的流量很少转化。

lines.en: Can we add negative keywords and tighten targeting?
lines.zh: 能否添加否定关键词并收紧定向？

lines.en: Yes, I'll also review the landing page by search intent.
lines.zh: 可以，我也会按搜索意图检查落地页。

lines.en: Monitor qualified conversions before increasing the budget again.
lines.zh: 再次增加预算前，先监测有效转化。

quiz: What should be optimized first?
quizZh: 应优先优化什么？
answer: Add negative keywords, tighten targeting and check landing pages against search intent.
answerZh: 添加否定关键词、收紧定向，并检查落地页是否符合搜索意图。

title: 媒介投放计划评审

lines.en: The proposed plan reaches most of our target audience.
lines.zh: 拟定方案能触达大部分目标受众。

lines.en: How much overlap is there between video and social placements?
lines.zh: 视频与社交广告版位之间有多少受众重叠？

lines.en: The overlap is high, so additional spend may mainly increase frequency.
lines.zh: 重叠度很高，因此额外投入可能主要增加曝光频次。

lines.en: Can we shift some budget to channels with incremental reach?
lines.zh: 能否将部分预算转向能带来增量触达的渠道？

lines.en: I'll model an alternative mix and compare the projected reach.
lines.zh: 我会模拟另一种组合并比较预计触达。

lines.en: Include the assumptions so we can assess the trade-offs.
lines.zh: 请列出假设，以便我们评估取舍。

quiz: Why consider a different channel mix?
quizZh: 为何考虑不同渠道组合？
answer: To reach additional people rather than mainly increasing exposure frequency among the same audience.
answerZh: 为了触达更多新增受众，而非主要增加同一受众的曝光频次。

title: 社交媒体运营会议

lines.en: Our educational posts receive more saves than promotional posts.
lines.zh: 知识科普类帖子比促销帖子获得更多收藏。

lines.en: The comments also contain recurring questions about product usage.
lines.zh: 评论中也反复出现产品使用方面的问题。

lines.en: Let's turn those questions into a weekly tutorial series.
lines.zh: 我们把这些问题做成每周教程系列吧。

lines.en: Should we respond to comments with links to the tutorials?
lines.zh: 我们是否应在回复评论时附上教程链接？

lines.en: Yes, but keep the replies personal and relevant.
lines.zh: 可以，但回复要个性化且切题。

lines.en: I'll track saves and useful conversations, not just follower growth.
lines.zh: 我会追踪收藏和有价值的互动，而不仅是粉丝增长。

quiz: What content should the team create?
quizZh: 团队应该制作什么内容？
answer: A weekly tutorial series answering recurring product questions.
answerZh: 每周推出解答常见产品使用问题的教程。

title: 达人合作谈判

lines.en: We'd like two short videos and one follow-up story.
lines.zh: 我们希望合作包含两条短视频和一条后续限时动态。

lines.en: Does the fee include paid advertising usage rights?
lines.zh: 费用包含付费广告使用权吗？

lines.en: We need thirty days of paid usage in the domestic market.
lines.zh: 我们需要国内市场三十天的付费使用权。

lines.en: We can quote that separately, with no automatic renewal.
lines.zh: 我们可以单独报价，且不自动续期。

lines.en: Please include the disclosure requirements and revision limits.
lines.zh: 请列明广告披露要求和修改次数限制。

lines.en: I'll send a revised proposal covering all those terms.
lines.zh: 我会发送包含所有这些条款的修订方案。

quiz: Which rights must be negotiated separately?
quizZh: 哪些权利需要单独协商？
answer: Paid advertising usage rights for thirty days in the domestic market, without automatic renewal.
answerZh: 国内市场为期三十天的付费广告使用权，不自动续期。

title: 内容策略讨论

lines.en: Our blog attracts traffic, but few readers request a demo.
lines.zh: 博客吸引了流量，但很少有读者申请演示。

lines.en: Are we producing enough content for buyers comparing solutions?
lines.zh: 我们是否为正在比较解决方案的买家制作了足够内容？

lines.en: Not yet. Most articles address early-stage questions.
lines.zh: 还没有。大部分文章解答早期阶段的问题。

lines.en: Let's develop comparison guides and customer case studies.
lines.zh: 我们制作对比指南和客户案例吧。

lines.en: I'll map each asset to a buying stage and add relevant calls to action.
lines.zh: 我会将每份内容对应到购买阶段，并添加相关行动号召。

lines.en: We'll measure assisted conversions as well as direct leads.
lines.zh: 我们既衡量辅助转化，也衡量直接线索。

quiz: How can content better support demand generation?
quizZh: 内容如何更好地支持需求开发？
answer: Create comparison guides and case studies for buyers evaluating solutions.
answerZh: 为正在比较解决方案的买家制作对比指南和客户案例。

title: 落地页A/B测试

lines.en: The new landing page has a higher conversion rate after two days.
lines.zh: 新落地页上线两天后转化率更高。

lines.en: We haven't reached the planned sample size yet.
lines.zh: 我们还没有达到计划样本量。

lines.en: Should we keep the test running until next week?
lines.zh: 我们是否应继续测试到下周？

lines.en: Yes, and we should check that traffic is allocated correctly.
lines.zh: 是的，还应检查流量分配是否正确。

lines.en: Let's avoid changing the offer during the experiment.
lines.zh: 实验期间不要改变优惠方案。

lines.en: Agreed. I'll report the confidence interval and lead quality when the test ends.
lines.zh: 同意。测试结束后我会汇报置信区间和线索质量。

quiz: Why not declare a winner now?
quizZh: 为什么现在不宣布胜出版本？
answer: The planned sample size has not yet been reached.
answerZh: 尚未达到预定样本量。

title: 代理商合作简报

lines.en: We need a proposal that covers both creative development and media execution.
lines.zh: 我们需要一份涵盖创意开发和媒介执行的方案。

lines.en: Could you clarify the scope of work and the approval process?
lines.zh: 能否明确工作范围和审批流程？

lines.en: Include three creative concepts, but budget for production separately.
lines.zh: 请提供三个创意概念，但制作费用单独列预算。

lines.en: We'll itemize the deliverables and specify two rounds of revisions.
lines.zh: 我们会逐项列出交付物，并明确两轮修改。

lines.en: Please also include a timeline with milestones and dependencies.
lines.zh: 请同时提供包含里程碑和依赖关系的时间表。

lines.en: I'll send the revised proposal by Friday for your review.
lines.zh: 我会在周五前发送修订方案供你审核。

quiz: What should be budgeted separately?
quizZh: 什么费用应单独列预算？
answer: Production costs should be budgeted separately.
answerZh: 制作费用应单独列入预算。

title: 供应商报价谈判

lines.en: Your quotation exceeds our approved budget by fifteen percent.
lines.zh: 你们的报价超出我们批准的预算百分之十五。

lines.en: The estimate includes installation and on-site technical support.
lines.zh: 估价包含安装和现场技术支持。

lines.en: Can you offer a volume discount if we consolidate the orders?
lines.zh: 如果我们合并订单，能否提供批量折扣？

lines.en: We can reduce the unit price by eight percent for a confirmed annual volume.
lines.zh: 如果确认年度采购量，我们可以将单价降低百分之八。

lines.en: Please specify the payment terms and cancellation fees in writing.
lines.zh: 请以书面形式明确付款条件和取消费用。

lines.en: I'll issue an updated quotation with those conditions.
lines.zh: 我会出具包含这些条件的新版报价单。

quiz: What condition is attached to the discount?
quizZh: 折扣附带什么条件？
answer: The discount depends on confirmation of annual order volume.
answerZh: 折扣以确认年度采购量为前提。

title: 渠道联合商业计划

lines.en: Our sell-in is strong, but sell-through is below forecast.
lines.zh: 我们的渠道进货表现不错，但终端销售低于预测。

lines.en: Several stores are carrying more inventory than they can sell.
lines.zh: 几家门店的库存超过了实际销售能力。

lines.en: Let's adjust replenishment and focus trade promotions on slow-moving stock.
lines.zh: 我们调整补货，并针对滞销库存开展渠道促销。

lines.en: We can share weekly inventory and point-of-sale data.
lines.zh: 我们可以共享每周库存和销售点数据。

lines.en: We'll link the next incentive payment to verified sell-through.
lines.zh: 我们将把下一笔激励款与经核实的终端销售表现挂钩。

lines.en: Agreed. I'll update our joint business plan accordingly.
lines.zh: 同意，我会据此更新联合商业计划。

quiz: What will determine the next incentive payment?
quizZh: 下一笔激励款取决于什么？
answer: Verified sell-through will determine the next incentive payment.
answerZh: 下一笔激励款取决于经核实的终端销售表现。

title: 门店陈列与促销评审

lines.en: The endcap display attracted traffic, but basket size stayed flat.
lines.zh: 端架陈列吸引了客流，但购物篮规模没有增长。

lines.en: Customers often pick up the featured item without buying complementary products.
lines.zh: 顾客经常只购买主推商品，而不购买搭配商品。

lines.en: Could we place complementary items next to the display?
lines.zh: 能否将搭配商品放在陈列旁边？

lines.en: Yes, provided we update the planogram and keep the aisle clear.
lines.zh: 可以，前提是更新货架陈列图并保持通道畅通。

lines.en: Let's test the layout in five stores and track units per transaction.
lines.zh: 我们在五家门店测试布局，并追踪每笔交易的商品件数。

lines.en: I'll brief the store teams and collect the results next week.
lines.zh: 我会向门店团队说明要求，并在下周收集结果。

quiz: Which metric will assess the new layout?
quizZh: 用什么指标评估新布局？
answer: Units per transaction (UPT).
answerZh: 每笔交易的商品件数（UPT）。

title: 会员权益优化

lines.en: Our redemption rate is low despite growing membership.
lines.zh: 尽管会员数量增长，积分兑换率仍然较低。

lines.en: We also have a growing points liability on the balance sheet.
lines.zh: 资产负债表上的积分负债也在增加。

lines.en: I'd like to test smaller rewards with a lower redemption threshold.
lines.zh: 我想测试兑换门槛更低的小额奖励。

lines.en: We should model the cost before changing the entire program.
lines.zh: 在调整整个计划前，我们应该测算成本。

lines.en: Let's run a pilot and monitor incremental purchases as well as redemption.
lines.zh: 我们开展试点，同时监测增量购买和兑换情况。

lines.en: I'll agree on a spending cap with you before the pilot starts.
lines.zh: 试点开始前，我会与你确定支出上限。

quiz: What should be monitored besides redemption?
quizZh: 除兑换外还应监测什么？
answer: Incremental purchases alongside reward redemption.
answerZh: 除奖励兑换情况外，还应监测增量购买。

title: 客户分群与自动化运营

lines.en: We want to send a win-back offer to inactive customers.
lines.zh: 我们希望向不活跃客户发送挽回优惠。

lines.en: How are you defining inactivity for customers with different purchase cycles?
lines.zh: 对于购买周期不同的客户，你如何定义不活跃？

lines.en: Let's use category-specific thresholds instead of a single cutoff.
lines.zh: 我们采用按品类划分的阈值，而不是统一截止标准。

lines.en: I'll exclude customers who have opted out of marketing emails.
lines.zh: 我会排除已退订营销邮件的客户。

lines.en: Keep a randomized holdout group so we can measure incremental response.
lines.zh: 保留随机留出对照组，以便衡量增量响应。

lines.en: I'll configure the triggered campaign and document the eligibility rules.
lines.zh: 我会配置触发式活动，并记录参与资格规则。

quiz: Why keep a holdout group?
quizZh: 为什么保留留出对照组？
answer: To estimate the incremental response to the win-back offer.
answerZh: 为了估算挽回优惠带来的增量响应。

title: 增长实验优先级评审

lines.en: Activation is our biggest funnel bottleneck this quarter.
lines.zh: 激活是本季度漏斗中最大的瓶颈。

lines.en: We have two ideas: simplify onboarding or offer a referral reward.
lines.zh: 我们有两个想法：简化新手引导或提供推荐奖励。

lines.en: The onboarding change addresses the bottleneck more directly.
lines.zh: 新手引导调整能更直接地解决瓶颈。

lines.en: It also requires less engineering effort than the referral program.
lines.zh: 它所需的研发投入也比推荐计划少。

lines.en: Let's define activation as completing the first order within seven days.
lines.zh: 我们将激活定义为七天内完成首笔订单。

lines.en: I'll estimate the sample size and agree on guardrail metrics before launch.
lines.zh: 上线前我会估算样本量并确定护栏指标。

quiz: How is activation defined in this experiment?
quizZh: 本次实验如何定义激活？
answer: A customer completes their first order within seven days.
answerZh: 客户在七天内完成首笔订单。

title: 营销投资回报分析

lines.en: The campaign generated attributed revenue of two million dollars.
lines.zh: 该活动产生了两百万美元的归因收入。

lines.en: How much of that revenue was actually incremental?
lines.zh: 其中有多少收入是真正的增量？

lines.en: Our holdout test suggests incremental revenue of eight hundred thousand dollars.
lines.zh: 留出对照实验表明增量收入为八十万美元。

lines.en: We should apply the contribution margin ratio before comparing it with campaign costs.
lines.zh: 与活动成本比较前，我们应该先计算边际贡献率。

lines.en: At a fifty percent contribution margin ratio, that gives us four hundred thousand dollars before campaign costs.
lines.zh: 按百分之五十的边际贡献率计算，扣除活动成本前为四十万美元。

lines.en: I'll present both attributed ROAS and incremental profit after campaign costs.
lines.zh: 我会同时汇报归因广告支出回报率和扣除活动成本后的增量利润。

quiz: What is the incremental contribution before campaign costs?
quizZh: 扣除活动成本前的增量贡献毛利是多少？
answer: Four hundred thousand dollars: $800,000 × 50%.
answerZh: 四十万美元：80万美元 × 50%。

title: 营销归因与增量评估

lines.en: Last-click attribution gives paid search most of the credit.
lines.zh: 末次点击归因将大部分转化贡献分配给付费搜索。

lines.en: That doesn't necessarily mean search caused all those conversions.
lines.zh: 这并不意味着搜索广告促成了所有这些转化。

lines.en: Could we run a geo experiment to estimate incremental lift?
lines.zh: 我们能否开展地理区域实验来估算增量提升？

lines.en: Yes, if we can select comparable regions and minimize spillover.
lines.zh: 可以，前提是选择可比区域并尽量减少外溢影响。

lines.en: Let's agree on the primary outcome and test duration in advance.
lines.zh: 我们提前确定主要结果指标和测试时长。

lines.en: I'll document the design and report uncertainty alongside the estimate.
lines.zh: 我会记录实验设计，并在汇报估计值时同时说明不确定性。

quiz: Why is last-click attribution insufficient to establish causality?
quizZh: 为什么末次点击归因不足以确定因果关系？
answer: It allocates conversion credit to the last eligible click but does not establish causal impact.
answerZh: 它将转化贡献分配给最后一次符合条件的点击，但不能证明因果影响。

title: 月度经营数据汇报

lines.en: Revenue is up twelve percent year over year, but gross margin has declined.
lines.zh: 收入同比增长百分之十二，但毛利率下降了。

lines.en: The sales mix shifted toward heavily discounted products.
lines.zh: 销售结构转向了折扣力度较大的产品。

lines.en: Can you separate the impact of pricing from the impact of volume?
lines.zh: 你能否区分价格和销量的影响？

lines.en: I'll prepare a variance analysis and reconcile it with Finance.
lines.zh: 我会准备差异分析，并与财务部门核对。

lines.en: We need a clear action plan, not just a list of metrics.
lines.zh: 我们需要明确的行动计划，而不仅是指标列表。

lines.en: I'll recommend reducing blanket discounts and testing targeted offers.
lines.zh: 我会建议减少普遍折扣，并测试定向优惠。

quiz: What action will the analyst recommend?
quizZh: 分析师将建议什么行动？
answer: Reduce blanket discounts and test targeted offers instead.
answerZh: 减少普遍折扣，改为测试定向优惠。

title: 海外市场进入评审

lines.en: Which market should we enter first?
lines.zh: 我们应该先进入哪个市场？

lines.en: Malaysia has lower entry costs, while Japan offers higher revenue potential.
lines.zh: 马来西亚的进入成本较低，而日本的收入潜力更高。

lines.en: Have we assessed the regulatory landscape and landed costs?
lines.zh: 我们评估过监管环境和到货总成本了吗？

lines.en: Yes, but our demand forecast still needs validation through a pilot.
lines.zh: 评估过了，但需求预测仍需通过试点验证。

lines.en: Let's run a limited launch in Malaysia before committing to a full rollout.
lines.zh: 我们先在马来西亚小规模上市，再决定是否全面推广。

lines.en: I'll define the success criteria and prepare an exit plan.
lines.zh: 我会明确成功标准并准备退出方案。

quiz: Why is the team proposing a limited launch?
answer: To validate demand in Malaysia before committing to a full rollout.
quizZh: 团队为何建议小规模上市？
answerZh: 先在马来西亚验证需求，再决定是否全面推广。

title: 全球品牌战略协同

lines.en: Which elements of the global campaign must remain consistent?
lines.zh: 全球营销活动中哪些元素必须保持一致？

lines.en: The brand promise and visual identity should remain unchanged.
lines.zh: 品牌承诺和视觉识别应保持不变。

lines.en: Our local team wants to replace the hero image with a regional customer story.
lines.zh: 当地团队希望用区域客户故事替换主视觉图片。

lines.en: That is acceptable if the story supports the same brand promise.
lines.zh: 如果故事支持相同的品牌承诺，就可以接受。

lines.en: Can we document the acceptable adaptations in the global playbook?
lines.zh: 我们能否在全球营销手册中记录允许的适配方式？

lines.en: Yes, I'll circulate the updated guidelines for regional approval.
lines.zh: 可以，我会分发更新后的指南供区域团队审批。

quiz: What must remain consistent across markets?
answer: The core brand promise and visual identity.
quizZh: 哪些元素必须在各市场保持一致？
answerZh: 核心品牌承诺与视觉识别。

title: 本地化创译评审

lines.en: The literal translation sounds unnatural in this market.
lines.zh: 直译在这个市场听起来不自然。

lines.en: I suggest transcreation to preserve the emotional appeal rather than the exact wording.
lines.zh: 我建议采用创译，保留情感诉求而不是原文字面表达。

lines.en: Can you keep the product claims within the approved terminology?
lines.zh: 你能确保产品宣传表述符合已批准的术语吗？

lines.en: Yes, I'll check the glossary and flag any claims that need legal review.
lines.zh: 可以，我会核对术语表并标记需要法务审核的宣传表述。

lines.en: Please arrange an in-market review before we publish the assets.
lines.zh: 请在素材发布前安排当地市场审核。

lines.en: I'll send two alternatives with explanations of the cultural nuances.
lines.zh: 我会提交两个备选方案，并解释文化细微差异。

quiz: Why does the copywriter recommend transcreation?
answer: To preserve the emotional appeal while making the copy sound natural in the target market.
quizZh: 文案人员为何建议创译？
answerZh: 保留情感诉求，同时让文案符合目标市场的语言习惯。

title: 跨文化沟通与区域协作

lines.en: I noticed the team raised concerns only after the meeting.
lines.zh: 我注意到团队在会议结束后才提出顾虑。

lines.en: Some colleagues prefer to share critical feedback in writing.
lines.zh: 有些同事更倾向于书面提出批评性反馈。

lines.en: Would an asynchronous review help everyone contribute?
lines.zh: 异步评审是否有助于每个人参与？

lines.en: Yes, especially if we circulate the proposal two days in advance.
lines.zh: 是的，尤其是提前两天分发方案的话。

lines.en: Let's record decisions and explicitly invite objections before sign-off.
lines.zh: 我们记录决策，并在签字确认前明确邀请大家提出异议。

lines.en: I'll set up a shared document with a deadline for comments.
lines.zh: 我会建立共享文档并设定反馈截止时间。

quiz: How will the team encourage feedback?
answer: Share proposals two days in advance and invite written feedback before sign-off.
quizZh: 团队将如何鼓励反馈？
answerZh: 提前两天分享方案，并在最终确认前邀请书面反馈。

title: 跨部门上市协作

lines.en: Sales has requested a launch date that engineering cannot support.
lines.zh: 销售提出的上市日期是工程团队无法支持的。

lines.en: The product is ready, but the integration documentation is not.
lines.zh: 产品已准备就绪，但集成文档尚未完成。

lines.en: Could we separate the announcement from general availability?
lines.zh: 我们能否将发布公告与正式可用时间分开？

lines.en: Yes, provided the messaging clearly states the availability date.
lines.zh: 可以，前提是传播信息明确说明可用日期。

lines.en: I'll update the campaign timeline and assign owners for each dependency.
lines.zh: 我会更新活动时间表，并为每项依赖指定负责人。

lines.en: Let's review launch readiness together before approving the announcement.
lines.zh: 我们在批准公告前共同评审上市准备情况吧。

quiz: What condition applies to an early announcement?
answer: The announcement must clearly state when the product will be available.
quizZh: 提前发布公告需要满足什么条件？
answerZh: 发布公告必须明确说明产品正式可用的日期。

title: 年度营销预算申请

lines.en: We're requesting a ten percent increase in next year's marketing budget.
lines.zh: 我们申请将明年的营销预算增加10%。

lines.en: What incremental contribution do you expect from the additional spend?
lines.zh: 你预计额外支出能带来多少增量贡献？

lines.en: Our pilot suggests positive returns, but the forecast includes a downside scenario.
lines.zh: 试点显示回报为正，但预测也包含下行情景。

lines.en: Can we release the additional budget in stages?
lines.zh: 我们能否分阶段拨付额外预算？

lines.en: Yes, we can tie each tranche to agreed performance milestones.
lines.zh: 可以，我们可以将每笔资金与约定的绩效里程碑挂钩。

lines.en: Please submit the assumptions and a contingency plan for approval.
lines.zh: 请提交假设条件及应急方案供审批。

quiz: How will the additional budget be released?
answer: Release the additional budget in stages linked to agreed performance milestones.
quizZh: 额外预算将如何释放？
answerZh: 按照约定的绩效里程碑分阶段拨付额外预算。

title: 季度经营复盘

lines.en: Revenue exceeded our quarterly target, but contribution margin fell.
lines.zh: 收入超过季度目标，但边际贡献下降了。

lines.en: The promotion increased volume while reducing the average selling price.
lines.zh: 促销提高了销量，但降低了平均售价。

lines.en: How much of the decline in contribution margin came from the discount?
lines.zh: 边际贡献下降有多少来自折扣？

lines.en: We're separating the price, volume and product mix effects.
lines.zh: 我们正在拆分价格、销量和产品组合的影响。

lines.en: Please include a recommendation for the next promotional cycle.
lines.zh: 请加入对下一轮促销的建议。

lines.en: I'll compare targeted offers with broad discounts and estimate their profit impact.
lines.zh: 我会比较定向优惠与普遍折扣，并估算利润影响。

quiz: Which effects is the analyst separating?
answer: The effects of price, sales volume and product mix.
quizZh: 分析师正在拆分哪些影响？
answerZh: 价格、销量及产品组合的影响。

title: 管理层战略汇报

lines.en: Our recommendation is to prioritize retention over broad acquisition next quarter.
lines.zh: 我们建议下季度优先留存，而非大范围获客。

lines.en: What evidence supports that strategic trade-off?
lines.zh: 有什么证据支持这一战略取舍？

lines.en: Recent cohorts show higher repeat purchase rates and shorter payback periods.
lines.zh: 近期同期群显示更高的复购率和更短的回收期。

lines.en: What would make you reverse the decision?
lines.zh: 什么情况会让你改变这一决策？

lines.en: If incremental profit falls below our agreed threshold, we'll reassess the allocation.
lines.zh: 如果增量利润低于约定门槛，我们将重新评估分配方案。

lines.en: Good. Include that trigger in the executive summary and confirm the review date.
lines.zh: 很好，请在执行摘要中写明该触发条件并确认复盘日期。

quiz: When will the team reassess the allocation?
answer: If incremental profit falls below the agreed threshold.
quizZh: 团队何时重新评估分配方案？
answerZh: 如果增量利润低于约定门槛。

title: 跨市场危机沟通

lines.en: A customer complaint is gaining attention in two markets.
lines.zh: 一条客户投诉正在两个市场引起关注。

lines.en: We have confirmed the complaint but not the underlying cause.
lines.zh: 我们已确认投诉存在，但尚未确认根本原因。

lines.en: Prepare a holding statement that acknowledges the concern without speculating.
lines.zh: 准备一份回应相关顾虑但不作推测的初步回应声明。

lines.en: Should we translate it immediately or wait for local legal review?
lines.zh: 我们应该立即翻译还是等待当地法务审核？

lines.en: Translate it now, but obtain local approval before publication.
lines.zh: 现在翻译，但发布前取得当地批准。

lines.en: I'll coordinate the spokesperson briefing and schedule the next update.
lines.zh: 我会协调发言人简报并安排下一次更新。

quiz: What must happen before publication?
answer: Obtain local approval of the translated holding statement before publication.
quizZh: 发布前必须完成什么？
answerZh: 发布前取得当地团队对初步回应声明译文的批准。

title: 预算调整与滚动预测

lines.en: Our media spend is below forecast, but event costs are higher than planned.
lines.zh: 媒介支出低于预测，但活动成本高于计划。

lines.en: How much of the remaining media budget is already committed?
lines.zh: 剩余媒介预算中有多少已经承诺支出？

lines.en: Half is committed under existing contracts; the rest is discretionary.
lines.zh: 一半已根据现有合同形成支出承诺，其余可酌情支配。

lines.en: We should protect the committed spend and review the marginal returns of each channel.
lines.zh: 我们应保留已承诺支出，并评估各渠道的边际回报。

lines.en: I'll prepare a revised forecast with two reallocation options.
lines.zh: 我会准备包含两种重新分配方案的修订预测。

lines.en: Let's agree on the preferred option before updating the cost centers.
lines.zh: 我们先确定首选方案，再更新成本中心记录。

quiz: Which part of the media budget can be considered for reallocation?
answer: The uncommitted, discretionary portion of the remaining media budget.
quizZh: 哪部分媒介预算可以考虑重新分配？
answerZh: 剩余媒介预算中尚未承诺支出、可酌情支配的部分。
